name: pockethunter-molstar-bridge
description: Vite-built bridge around Mol* that re-exposes the selection / representation APIs the runtime UMD viewer-bundle hides. Output is committed at static/js/molstar-bridge.js so the Streamlit container doesn't need Node.

scripts.build: vite build && cp dist/molstar-bridge.iife.js ../static/js/molstar-bridge.js && cp dist/style.css ../static/js/molstar-bridge.css
